title: Memory searched by meaning with the local model 35.0 chose
request: The owner: continue the memory plan to the end; 35.0's verdict let embeddings into memory search.
spec: MEMORY_PLAN.md 35.5: each item's vector through the gateway on a local model, recall by meaning as 35.0 measured, vectors recomputed when the model changes.
plan: Route a local embedding model through the gateway for memory only.
Keep vectors per model and use them in recall.
Check on the real local model, review, fix, commit.

decisions.decision: Memory gets its own purpose and settings instead of sharing the evidence search's
decisions.why: the evidence search serves a method measured on another model; one setting with two meanings would switch it to an unmeasured one

decisions.decision: Vectors in a JSON file per model and weights, not pgvector
decisions.why: a workspace's memory is small; the file keeps the database unchanged and the digest separates weights pulled again

decisions.decision: recall falls back to words when the local model fails
decisions.why: a stopped Ollama must not break an agent's turn; before 35.5 words answered

change: models/settings.py (memory_embedding purpose, embedding_tier on DCLAB_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_*), models/gateway.py (that purpose served by the local tier only; routing never moves it), agents/harness.py, memory/vectors.py (new), memory/reading.py (by meaning with a fallback), memory/tools.py, tests/run_parallel.py (the two settings blanked), .env.example (these and the thinking settings), tests.

findings.defect: The first live check sent the request to the Claude client
findings.scenario: with the local model set, recall raised 'Anthropic serves no embeddings'
findings.cause: before each request the client followed the routing table, which put the purpose back on the cheap tier
findings.fix: the local tier is never moved by routing
findings.impact: memory search by meaning would never have worked in the product; the test had used one fake transport for every tier

findings.defect: recall failed when the local model was down
findings.scenario: Ollama stopped: recall raised and the agent's turn failed
findings.fix: by words when the model fails

findings.defect: A chosen model was ignored on the local tier
findings.cause: the fixed tier kept its own model
findings.fix: the asked model replaces the tier's

findings.scenario: DCLAB_EMBEDDING_MODEL also names the evidence search's model; setting it for memory would switch the evidence search to an unmeasured model
findings.cause: reuse of the evidence search's setting and purpose

findings.defect: Vectors named by the tag only, a race between processes, no size limit, a private project's notes sent
findings.scenario: weights pulled again under the same tag mixed vectors; two writers lost each other's vectors; the file grew forever; a private project's notes went to the model
findings.cause: file per tag, a thread lock, no pruning, no project on the request
findings.fix: the digest in the file name, the folder's lock and unique temporary files, at most 20,000 vectors, the project on the request

findings.defect: The suite read the owner's .env for the new settings, and fake keys in tests tripped the secret scan
findings.scenario: with the settings exported a test changed its answer; test_config flagged two test lines
findings.cause: the runner did not blank them; key-shaped strings in tests
findings.fix: the runner blanks them; the fake keys are built at run time; the thinking settings documented

measurements.name: live local check, embeddinggemma:300m-qat-q8_0 through the gateway
measurements.gate: three questions sharing no word with their answer line (one in Persian) each find that line first
measurements.result: three of three found their line first: a call's cost, how to answer the owner (asked in Persian), the held-out period
measurements.against_gate: three of three against three of three
limits: three questions on three invented lines: a smoke check of the wiring, not a measurement of quality (35.0 measured that)

outcome: Memory is searched by meaning on the local model 35.0 chose, through its own gateway purpose, with vectors kept per model and weights and a fallback to words. Ten review findings fixed; the live check found the routing bug the tests had hidden.
lessons: A fake that answers every tier the same hides routing bugs: make the fake tell the tiers apart.
Never give one setting a second meaning: give the new user its own name.
risks: A stopped local model degrades memory search to words silently (logged on stderr).
